ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have successfully completed JOUR 217 or JOUR 340 will learn advanced videography, editing and reporting skills to be on-air reporters for the Good Morning Illini show. Class will also include on-camera talent lab for Good Morning Illini's live broadcast on Fridays. Meets with JOUR 217 (73181) and JOUR 417 (73394). Please note: Pre-req's that will be enforced this semester are: JOUR 340 or JOUR 480 KRE TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 34913 or FA 71504) or JOUR 199 TVP TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 64995 or FA 51646). An additional note: JOUR 317 is repeatable once. However, JOUR 480 KRE TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 34913 or FA 71504) and JOUR 199 TVP TV Prod: Good Morning Illini (SP 64995 or FA 51646) are both equivalent to this course. Students can only receive credit twice for any combination of JOUR 317, JOUR 199 TVP and JOUR 480 KRE.
